"🎮 0. GAME IDENTITY

> A turn-based, physics-inspired, probabilistic PvP combat system implemented via Telegram, where player decisions + build design determine outcomes.



Core principles:

- No level progression
- Equal-value parts
- No hard caps
- Emergent penalties
- Skill > randomness
- No dominant meta


---

🧱 1. BEYBLADE CONSTRUCTION SYSTEM

Each Beyblade:

CORE + BLADE + DISC + TIP


---

🔹 CORE (Cosmetic Only)

- Defines name + color
- No stats

Examples:

Aetherion, Draknor, Nyxalon, Pyronis, Zephyros...


---

🔹 BLADE (Attack + Lock)

AP + LI = 80 (constant)


---

🔹 DISC (Mass + Stability)

MS + ST = 100 (constant)


---

🔹 TIP (Mobility + Stamina)

MB + SM = 100 (constant)


---

🔹 Resulting Stats

AP → Attack Power
ST → Stability
SM → Stamina
MB → Mobility
MS → Mass
LI → Lock Integrity


---

⚖️ 2. CORE DESIGN LAW (VERY IMPORTANT)

> Stat conservation + nonlinear interaction = balance



Meaning:

- No part is stronger
- Only distribution differs
- Extremes create self-penalties naturally


---

🧠 3. TYPE CLASSIFICATION

Computed after build:

Attack Type   → AP + MB dominant
Defense Type  → ST + MS dominant
Stamina Type  → SM dominant
Balance Type  → none dominant


---

⚙️ 4. MATCH STRUCTURE

20–30 steps (dynamic)
Each step:
1. Players choose actions
2. Resolve engagement
3. Resolve collision (if any)
4. Apply system effects
5. Update state
6. Check win condition


---

🧩 5. PLAYER STATE

Static:

AP, ST, SM, MB, MS, LI


---

Dynamic:

energy = SM × 1.2
stability_level
position_pressure
passive_pressure
special_meter (0–100)

guard_stack
dodge_stack
combo_count

last_action
repeat_count


---

🎯 6. ACTION SYSTEM

Each step:

ATTACK
DEFEND
DODGE
CHARGE
SPECIAL (if meter full)


---

⚙️ 7. ENGAGEMENT ENGINE

Collision Probability

P = 0.4 + (MB₁ + MB₂)/200

Modifiers:

ATTACK → +0.15
DODGE → −0.25 × decay

Clamp:

0.2–0.9


---

🌀 8. PASSIVE PRESSURE (ANTI-STALL)

If no collision:

passive_pressure += 3

On collision:

position_pressure += passive_pressure
reset passive_pressure


---

💥 9. IMPACT SYSTEM

Base Impact

Impact = AP × (1 + MB/120)


---

Action Multipliers

ATTACK → ×1.5
DEFEND → ×0.6 incoming
DODGE → ×0.7 outgoing
CHARGE → ×0.5
SPECIAL → ×5.0


---

Type Synergy (Skill Layer)

Attack → +15% attack
Defense → −20% incoming (DEFEND), −15% recoil
Stamina → −20% energy drain, +25% charge gain
Balance → +5% all


---

Specialization Scaling

Threshold-based bonuses:

AP > 50 → +0.6%/point
ST > 70 → +0.5% resistance/point
SM > 70 → −0.4% drain/point
MB > 70 → +0.5% collision rate/point
MS > 70 → +0.5% ring-out resist/point
LI > 50 → +0.7% burst resist/point


---

Momentum (Anti-passive attack)

combo_count ≥ 2:
+5% impact per stack (max 15%)
+5% recoil per stack


---

Initiative Bonus

If opponent uses DODGE or CHARGE:

+8% impact
+5% burst chance


---

Randomness

× random(0.9–1.1)

Small, controlled.


---

⚖️ 10. COLLISION RESOLUTION


---

A. Stability Damage

StabilityLoss = Impact / ST


---

B. Recoil

Recoil = Impact / ST_self


---

C. Position Pressure

position_pressure += Impact / MS


---

D. Burst Check

BurstChance = Impact × (MS / LI)

Modifiers:

- Charging → ×1.2
- Initiative → +5%


---

E. Energy Loss

energy -= Impact / 20


---

⚡ 11. ENERGY SYSTEM


---

Passive Drain

energy -= 1 + MB/80

Stamina Type:

×0.8


---

Pressure Drain

If:

pressure > 70

energy -= pressure / 50


---

🛡️ 12. DEFENSE FATIGUE

guard_stack += 1
reduction = 20% − (5% × stack)
min = 5%

Reset on non-defend.


---

🌀 13. DODGE DECAY

dodge_stack += 1
effectiveness -= 10% × stack


---

🔋 14. CHARGE SYSTEM

special_meter += 15

Stamina Type:

+25%

Penalty:

incoming damage ×1.25
burst risk ×1.2


---

💠 15. SPECIAL ATTACK

Impact ×5
special_meter → 0

High risk due to recoil + exposure.


---

🌪️ 16. ARENA DESTABILIZATION

Each turn:

global_instability += 1
EffectiveST -= 0.5% per turn


---

🔁 17. ADAPTATION BONUS

If player breaks repetition:

+5% next action effectiveness


---

🧠 18. SPECIALIZATION IDENTITY

If dominant stat ≥ 1.25× others:

+8% domain efficiency


---

🏁 19. WIN CONDITIONS


---

Burst Finish

burst triggered → instant loss


---

Ring-Out

pressure > 120 → probability roll


---

Spin Finish

energy ≤ 0 → loss


---

🧠 20. STRATEGIC META STRUCTURE


---

Attack Builds

- High burst potential
- Risk: recoil + instability


---

Defense Builds

- Stable
- Weak if passive


---

Stamina Builds

- Long-game
- Vulnerable to pressure


---

Balance Builds

- Safe
- Outclassed by specialists


---

⚙️ 21. TELEGRAM SYSTEM


---

Commands

/start
/help
/build
/challenge @user


---

Match Flow

Challenge → Accept → Build Select → Battle Loop → Result


---

Message System

- Single message
- Edited each step
- Inline buttons only


---

Action Callback

action:{match_id}:{player_id}:{move}


---

🧱 22. DATA MODEL


---

User

{
  user_id,
  builds[],
  default_build_id
}


---

Match

{
  match_id,
  players,
  states,
  step,
  message_id,
  pending_actions
}


---

⏱️ 23. TIMEOUT SYSTEM

60 seconds

If timeout:

random choice → DEFEND or DODGE


---

🔒 24. CONCURRENCY RULE

ONE match = ONE lock

No parallel processing.


---

🚨 25. SYSTEM GUARANTEES


---

✔ No dominant strategy

✔ No infinite stall

✔ No spam exploit

✔ No build superiority

✔ Player skill matters


---

⚠️ 26. KNOWN TRADE-OFFS

Be honest here:

- Not beginner-friendly
- Requires learning curve
- UI must guide player properly


---

🧾 FINAL VERDICT

What you’ve built is:

> A competitive simulation system disguised as a simple Telegram game



It has:

- mechanical depth
- emergent balance
- strategic diversity
- strong replayability

---
